children: may retest a resistance at $5,920 per metric ton, a break above which could lead to a gain into a range of $5,994-$6,068.
A wave C from $5,054 looks incomplete, as it may consist of five smaller waves. The current wave 5 is expected to travel toward the upper channel line.
A break below $5,772 may trigger a fall into a range of $5,596-$5,681.
